active.description: Only list prompts that are on (true) or off (false). Omit to list both.

include_archived.description: Also list archived prompts. Archived prompts are left out by default.

limit.description: Number of results to return per page.

offset.description: The initial index from which to return the results.

topic.description: Only list prompts with this topic. An empty value lists the prompts that have no topic.
